market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $120 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month near $100-107 with intraday volatility above $107 today. Reaching $120 intraday in May requires another ~15% spike on top of existing premium, plausible if Hormuz situation deteriorates further (full closure scenario). ING and others list $120+ as upside scenario.
data_sources: ING oil forecasts raised on Hormuz disruption
assessment.key_uncertainty: Severity and persistence of Strait of Hormuz disruption
